component.name: Deskscape
component.summary: Live 3D wallpaper with widgets, like Wallpaper Engine

description.p: Deskscape is a live wallpaper engine for the COSMIC desktop. It replaces your wallpaper with a living 3D scene: add widgets and an app launcher, drop in 3D objects, and let the camera follow your mouse like the main menu of a game. Your windows stay on top as usual.

ul.li: Camera that moves with your mouse: parallax, orbit or fixed
3D shapes or your own .glb models, with glass, metal, glowing and cartoon materials
Objects can spin, float, turn toward the mouse, be grabbed and spun, or open an app when clicked

22 widgets: clock, world clocks, countdown, focus timer, calendar, dock, app launcher, search, quick links, system monitor, live graphs, now playing, moon phase, notes, to-do list, quotes, photo slideshow and more
Frosted glass, liquid glass, neon and outline widget styles
Full-screen app drawer with search and categories, plus a magnifying dock
Restyle COSMIC's real panel and dock: seven taskbar layouts, applets, pinned apps, colors and auto-hide, with one-click restore
Turn on COSMIC's frosted glass windows, panel and menus
Interface sounds and ten ambient soundscapes, from rain and fireplace to deep space
Animated aurora and flowing backgrounds, images or looping videos, plus stars, snow, rain, fireflies and bubbles
20 ready-made looks, from Sunflower Field and Above the Clouds to Cyber HUD and Galaxy, each with its own soundscape, plus your own saved looks
Right-click the desktop for quick actions, and hold Alt to drag widgets
Use your own sound files for interface sounds and the background
Pauses while a window is maximized or while you use an app, like Wallpaper Engine
Real 360° skies and free 3D models from Poly Haven's CC0 library (optional), or your own 360° photos
Set COSMIC's lock screen to a picture of your scene
No accounts, ads or tracking; offline unless you use the online library

description.p: Deskscape is made for the COSMIC desktop on Pop!_OS and works on other Wayland desktops that support layer-shell. On other desktops it opens in a normal window.

description.p: Easier to use, your own sounds, and flower fields.

ul.li: Right-click the desktop for quick actions: add widgets, change the look, pause, mute, set the lock screen
Move widgets right on the desktop: hold Alt and drag, or choose Move widgets
Use your own sound files for clicks, opening apps, the timer and the background
Save your own looks and switch back to them any time
New Sunflower Field and Wildflower Meadow presets, and fields of flowers or grass for any scene
Fixed: the wallpaper could stay paused when nothing covered it; it now keeps running as soon as your mouse is on it
Live 3D wallpaper with a mouse-driven camera, 360° skies, 3D objects and models, particles and animated backgrounds
22 widgets, a magnifying dock and a full-screen app drawer
Restyles COSMIC's real panel, dock, applets, pinned apps, glass, windows and lock screen, with one-click restore
Pauses while a window is maximized or while you use an app, like Wallpaper Engine
Interface sounds and ten ambient soundscapes
18 ready-made looks
